shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g 'package.json' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -80'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/instant-navigation.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/prefetching.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && rg --files app components lib | head -200'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat app/catalog/page.tsx && cat app/page.tsx && rg -n "catalog|category|loading|prefetch|Link" app components lib 2>/dev/null'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/optimizing-prefetching.md'
/bin/bash -lc "cat lib/data.ts && rg --files -g 'next.config.*' -g '*test*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g 'README*' -g 'app/**' -g 'lib/**' -g '"'!node_modules'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "partialPrefetching|cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/04-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js 2>/dev/null | head -50'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git status --short && rg -n "cacheLife|use cache|partialPrefetching|prefetch" app lib next.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next.config.ts app/page.tsx lib/data.ts && npx tsc --noEmit'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'prefetch|Catalog|Loading category|Featured products|Products on sale' .next/server/app/catalog* .next/server/app/index* .next/server/app/page* 2>/dev/null | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || true && rg --files node_modules | rg '("'^|/)(playwright|puppeteer)(/|$)'"' | head -15"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start -- --port 3100'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/catalog-sale-prefetch.rsc -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale' | head -40 && rg -o 'Products on sale|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-sale-prefetch.rsc | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/catalog-featured-prefetch.rsc -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured' | head -40 && rg -o 'Featured products|Desk Lamp|Wool Blanket|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-featured-prefetch.rsc | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sSL -D /tmp/catalog-featured-headers -o /tmp/catalog-featured-prefetch.rsc -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured' && tail -25 /tmp/catalog-featured-headers && rg -o 'Featured products|Desk Lamp|Wool Blanket|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-featured-prefetch.rsc | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sSL -D /tmp/catalog-sale-headers -o /tmp/catalog-sale-prefetch.rsc -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale' && tail -25 /tmp/catalog-sale-headers && rg -o 'Products on sale|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-sale-prefetch.rsc | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/catalog-featured-html-headers -o /tmp/catalog-featured.html 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured' && head -20 /tmp/catalog-featured-html-headers && rg -o 'Featured products|Desk Lamp|Wool Blanket|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-featured.html | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/catalog-sale-html-headers -o /tmp/catalog-sale.html 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale' && head -20 /tmp/catalog-sale-html-headers && rg -o 'Products on sale|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-sale.html | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .next/server/app/catalog.segments/catalog/__PAGE__.segment.rsc | head -30'

/bin/bash -lc "cat .next/server/app/catalog.meta && rg -n 'next-router-segment-prefetch|Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch|segmentPrefetch' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache-impl node_modules/next/dist/client/components 2>/dev/null | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/featured-segment-headers -o /tmp/featured-segment.rsc -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /catalog/__PAGE__' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured' && head -25 /tmp/featured-segment-headers && rg -o 'Featured products|Desk Lamp|Wool Blanket|Loading category' /tmp/featured-segment.rsc | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/sale-segment-headers -o /tmp/sale-segment.rsc -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /catalog/__PAGE__' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale' && head -25 /tmp/sale-segment-headers && rg -o 'Products on sale|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug|Loading category' /tmp/sale-segment.rsc | sort -u"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit'
